Applicants must submit one original and seven photocopies of the duly filled-in application form along with self-attested copies of testimonials with the first original copy.

content_sections.heading: Vidyasagar University Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: There are a total of 6 vacancies available under this notification.

rows.post_name: Training and Placement Officer (Purely on contract basis)
Assistant Professor (Population, Health and Development) (Purely on contract basis)

rows.qualification_required: MBBS degree from recognized University affiliated to Medical Council of India, Registration Certificate from West Bengal Medical Council or Medical Council of India, and at least 10 years' experience of medical practice in a Government / Military / Quasi Government hospital (10 years' experience in hospital may be relaxed in case of private practice of reputation for 15 years). Desirable: Post graduate Degree in any of the branches of Medical Science or Diploma in Public and Tropical Medicine.

Uniformly good academic record with a Master's Degree with minimum 55% marks or its equivalent grade, at least 10 years' experience in a supervisory capacity in a University or a Research Institute or a Government/ Quasi Government organisation, and at least 5 years' administrative experience. Desirable: A degree in Business Management or Law or Statistics or Planning.

rows.post: Training and Placement Officer (Purely on contract basis)
rows.qualification_required: Uniformly good academic record with a Master's Degree with minimum 55% marks or its equivalent grade, and minimum of 7 years' experience in the supervisory capacity in an organization engaged in production or in teaching in a recognized Institute of Post Graduate Learning. Desirable: Experience in Major Industrial capacity in India particularly in West Bengal OR Experience in marketing or sales activities of a public sector organization.
Good academic record with at least 55% marks at Masters Degree level in LLM (Specialization: Business Law) along with NET/SLET/SET or Ph.D. exemption as per UGC norms.

rows.post: Assistant Professor (Population, Health and Development) (Purely on contract basis)
rows.qualification_required: Good academic record with at least 55% marks at Masters Degree level in a relevant subject (Specialization: Population and Demography / Health and Population Geography / Population and Development Studies / Urban and Regional Planning / Population and Environmental Studies / Gender and Development Studies / Regional Development and Planning / Human Geography / Population and Social Development) along with NET/SLET/SET or Ph.D. exemption as per UGC norms.
Good academic record with at least 55% marks at Masters Degree level in Santali (Specialization: Linguistics) along with NET/SLET/SET or Ph.D. exemption as per UGC norms.

faq.question: Q1. What is Vidyasagar University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Vidyasagar University Recruitment 2026 is an employment notification (VU/R/Advt./03/2026) inviting applications for 6 vacancies across Medical Officer, Assistant Registrar, Training and Placement Officer, and Assistant Professor posts.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Vidyasagar University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 6 vacancies are available under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Vidyasagar University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit completed applications is 27 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for the Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree from a recognized University affiliated to the Medical Council of India, a valid Registration Certificate, and at least 10 years of medical practice experience in a Government, Military, or Quasi-Government hospital.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for Vidyasagar University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 800/- for Sl. No. 01 (Medical Officer) and Rs. 600/- for Sl. No. 02, 03, and 04, payable via Bank Draft in favour of "Vidyasagar University" payable at Midnapore.
